id: Squirtle decided it would like to join you. Would you like to take Squirtle with you?
en: Squirtle decided it would like to join you. Would you like to take Squirtle with you?
it: Squirtle ha deciso che vorrebbe unirsi a te. Vuoi portare Squirtle con te?

id: \bJames: You again? Are you here to stop our plans to use the Squirtle?
en: \bJames: You again? Are you here to stop our plans to use the Squirtle?
it: \bJames: Ancora tu? Sei qui per fermare i nostri piani per sfruttare gli Squirtle?
